findings: components[1].origin_relation: the visible 心 is described as lower breath strokes later regularized toward 心, but origin_form 𠂤 is not supported as the earlier form of those strokes; the source says breath strokes, not 𠂤. Set origin_form to an evidenced form or empty, and use origin_relation "uncertain" or "none" accordingly. The phonetic role for 心 is also asserted in the component roles despite the component text attributing it only to a secondary account; retain the proposed role only if that account is explicitly cited and distinguished from the competing semantic and graphic-regularization analyses.

formation.type: the text describes competing constructions but never identifies a supported construction type. The received dictionary analysis is explicitly a 心+自 analysis with 自 phonetic, while other accounts treat components semantically or describe breath strokes later regularized as 心. Use "disputed" only if this field currently has that value; otherwise set it to "disputed" and keep the accounts distinct, without presenting any one construction as settled.

learner.overview: the phrase “meaningful 自 and 心” overstates the cited disagreement: one account treats both as semantic, another assigns 自 a sound role, and another describes lower breath strokes later regularized toward 心. Replace this compressed list with a concise qualified account that keeps those analyses distinct; the existing learner component cards can carry the detail.
